svg.aria-label: Closed-loop step response of G = 100(0.3s + 1) over (0.5s + 1)(s squared + 2s + 5) with unity feedback: it oscillates and settles at 20/21 = 0.952, leaving a steady-state error of 1/21

g.text: Type 0 loop: Kp = 20, so e_ss = 1/(1 + 20) = 0.048 for a unit step
